Black Duck - Gin CVE-2023-29401 (HIGH) - Directory traversal vulnerability
prBodyNotes: **Description**: Directory traversal vulnerability in gin-gonic/gin allows attackers to access files outside the intended directory.
**Remediation**: Update github.com/gin-gonic/gin to version 1.9.1. Constrained to 1.9.x to minimize breaking changes and avoid unnecessary major version jumps.
This PR was created based on Black Duck security scan findings.
